```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(DESeq2)
library(Seurat)
library("textTinyR")
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)

```


```{r function}

make_idents_counts <- function(
    ds,
    idents_choose="seurat_clusters",
    assay_="RNA",
    slot_="counts",
    min_cell_num=200,
    keep=NULL){
        
        Idents(ds) <- idents_choose
        group_names <- unique(Idents(ds))
        if (!is.null(keep)) {group_names <- keep
          
        }
        reads <- slot(ds, "assays")[[assay_]] %>% slot(slot_)
        reads <- reads[rownames(reads) %>% str_subset(pattern = "[.]",negate = T),]
        sum_counts_ds <- tibble(.rows =  nrow(reads))
        #z=1
        for (i in seq_along(group_names)) {
          print(i)
          #print(colnames(sum_counts_ds))
          print(group_names[i])
          i_cells <- WhichCells(object =ds,idents = group_names[i])
          if (length(i_cells)<min_cell_num) {
            sum_counts_ds <- sum_counts_ds %>%
            add_column(dings=0)
          colnames(sum_counts_ds)[i] <- paste0(as.character(group_names[i]),"_smaller" , as.character(min_cell_num))
          # print(paste0(as.character(group_names[i]),"_smaller" , as.character(min_cell_num)))
          # print(i)
            
            #if (z==2) (return(sum_counts_ds))
          #z=z+1
          next}
          #i_cells <- WhichCells(object =ds,idents = "hla_d_rlo_s100a_monocytes_C19-CB-0003")
          sum_counts_ds <- sum_counts_ds %>%
            add_column(dings=reads[,i_cells] %>%  sparse_Sums(rowSums=T))
          colnames(sum_counts_ds)[i] <- as.character(group_names[i])
          #print(as.character(colnames(sum_counts_ds)[i]))
          
        }
        #colnames(sum_counts_ds) <- group_names
        sum_counts_ds <- sum_counts_ds %>%  mutate(gene=rownames(reads)) %>% relocate(gene)
        return(sum_counts_ds)
}

```
```{r}
path_data_file <- "..\\..\\..\\raw_data\\schulte_schrepping_et_al\\"
path_output_file <- ".\\output\\"
```

```{r}
seurat_monocytes <-  read_rds(paste0(path_data_file,
                                     "schulte_schrepping_monocytes_from_seurat_COVID19_PBMC_cohort1_10x_jonas_FG_2020-08-15.rds"))

seurat_monocytes$donor_condition_exp <- paste0(seurat_monocytes$donor, "__",
                                           seurat_monocytes$group_per_sample,"__",
                                           seurat_monocytes$experiment)

keep <- tibble(
               donor=seurat_monocytes$donor ,
               condition=seurat_monocytes$group_per_sample,
               experiment=seurat_monocytes$experiment) %>%
  group_by(donor,condition,experiment) %>% 
  summarise(n=n()) %>% filter(n>50, condition %in% c("mild","severe"#,"control"
                                                 )) %>% 
  ungroup()%>% 
  mutate(keep=paste0(donor,"__",
                     condition,"__",
                     experiment
                     )) %>% 
  pull(keep)


```
```{r}
ds_monocytes <-  make_idents_counts(seurat_monocytes,
                                        idents_choose = "donor_condition_exp",
                                        keep = keep,
                                        min_cell_num=49)

#ds_monocytes_100 %>% write_rds( paste0(path_output_file,"bulk_sums_monocytes_donor_100.rds") )
```

```{r}
x <- ds_monocytes %>% select(!(contains("_smaller"))) %>% ungroup()# _smaller doesnt work
expression_matrix <- as.matrix(x %>% select(-gene)) 
rownames(expression_matrix) <- x %>% pull(gene)
```


```{r}
design_x <-colnames(expression_matrix)%>% 
  tibble(dings=.) %>% separate(col= dings,into = c("donor","condition","experiment"),sep = "__") %>%mutate_all(as_factor) %>% arrange(condition)
design_x
reihenfolge <- paste0(design_x %>% pull(donor),"__", design_x%>% pull(condition),"__",design_x %>% pull(experiment))
expression_matrix <- expression_matrix[,reihenfolge]
colnames(expression_matrix)
```

##unforutnately contition is a linear combination of experiment and cannot be used as covariat, means experiment is not properly blocked

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

clusters <- unique(design_x$condition)
res_list <- vector(mode="list", length = 0)
for (cluster in clusters) {
  design_cluster <- design_x %>% mutate(condition=fct_other(condition,keep = cluster)) %>% select(condition)
  print(design_cluster)
  res_list[[cluster]]<- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(expression_matrix,
                              colData=design_cluster,
                              design= ~ condition ) %>% DESeq()
  
}




resultsNames(res_list[["mild"]])
resultsNames(res_list[["severe"]])


write_rds(res_list, paste0(path_output_file,"deseq_monocytes_condition_results_list.rds"))
```

```{r}
res_severe_other <- results( res_list[["severe"]], 
                                          contrast= c("condition", "severe", "Other")) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene")


res_mild_other <- results( res_list[["mild"]], 
                                          contrast= c("condition", "mild", "Other")) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene")





res_severe_other %>% filter(log2FoldChange>0) %>% mutate(neg_log_p=-log(pvalue)) %>% arrange(-neg_log_p)
res_severe_other%>% arrange(-log2FoldChange)%>% ggplot(aes(log2FoldChange, -log(padj))) + geom_point()
res_severe_other%>% arrange(-log2FoldChange)%>% ggplot(aes(log2FoldChange, pvalue)) + geom_point()


res_mild_other %>% filter(log2FoldChange>0) %>% arrange(pvalue)
res_mild_other%>% arrange(-log2FoldChange) %>% ggplot(aes(log2FoldChange, -log(padj))) + geom_point()

```
